43	class RequestIdMiddleware(BaseHTTPMiddleware):
44	    """요청마다 `X-Request-ID`를 발급/전달해 로그 상관관계를 확보한다."""
45	
46	    async def dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next):
47	        request_id = request.headers.get("x-request-id") or uuid.uuid4().hex
48	        request.state.request_id = request_id
49	        logger.info(
50	            "요청 수신: id=%s method=%s path=%s",
51	            request_id,
52	            request.method,
53	            request.url.path,
54	        )
55	        response = await call_next(request)
56	        response.headers["X-Request-ID"] = request_id
57	        return response
